title: A Jellyfish With No Brain Has 24 Eyes and Uses Them to Steer

scenes.text: A jellyfish with no brain has 24 eyes.
Box jellyfish eyes come in four different types.
Four of them always point up at the sky, no matter how the animal tilts.
They spot the mangrove canopy from at least eight meters away and swim toward it.
Block that view, and the jellyfish can't find its way.
No brain, 24 eyes, and it still knows where it's going.

description:
A jellyfish with no brain has 24 eyes.
Caribbean box jellyfish have four kinds of eyes, and four of them always look up through the water to the mangrove canopy. Researchers found they steer by it, even though the animal has no true brain.
How do you steer without a brain? Comment below.
first_comment: A jellyfish steers by looking at trees. What's the strangest sense you know of in an animal?
